summary: MDA Space Ltd. filed this material change report on Form 6-K disclosing its firm and irrevocable offer to acquire a ~70% majority interest in Collecte Localisation Satellites (CLS) for approx. €567 million (C$920 million) in cash, with the French space agency CNES retaining ~30%. Concurrently, the company completed a bought-deal equity offering of 23,000,000 common shares at US$35.60 per share, raising US$819 million in gross proceeds to fund the acquisition, repay CLS indebtedness (~€198 million if not refinanced), and pay fees. The board recommended the transaction; BMO, RBC, J.P. Morgan, Scotiabank, and BofA acted as underwriters. The acquisition requires French employee consultation and regulatory approvals, with expected close by end-2026 or early 2027. Watch for regulatory clearances and any competing bids.
